mcmusic.title: Music Toast Options
mcmusic.enabled.tooltip: Enable or disable the music toast feature
mcmusic.source.tooltip: Choose the music source: Minecraft, System, or Both
mcmusic.source.unsupported.tooltip: System media is not supported on this OS; source is limited to Minecraft only
mcmusic.display.tooltip: Controls how the in-game music toast is displayed (via vanilla option)
mcmusic.location.tooltip: Choose whether the system-media toast shows in the HUD only, or in the HUD and pause menu
mcmusic.trigger.tooltip: Controls when the system media toast appears (three mutually exclusive modes)
mcmusic.multi_source.tooltip: Show multiple simultaneously-playing system sources at once (Windows / Linux only, up to %s)
mcmusic.multi_source.unsupported.tooltip: This OS cannot enumerate multiple sources (macOS Now Playing exposes only the current track)
mcmusic.mac_apps.title: Allowed Media Apps
mcmusic.mac_apps.list_header: Choose which media apps to read from
mcmusic.mac_apps.entry.tooltip: Choose which media apps the mod is allowed to read from
mcmusic.mac_apps.not_installed.tooltip: This app was not detected on the system and cannot be used
mcmusic.mac_apps.unknown.tooltip: Automation permission not yet granted. Enabling will trigger a permission dialog on the next poll
mcmusic.mac_apps.denied.tooltip: Permission denied. Go to macOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation to grant access
mcmusic.mac_apps.macos_settings.tooltip: Open macOS System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation
mcmusic.test.tooltip: Preview the system media toast appearance
mcmusic.backend.tooltip: Shows the current system media backend. Hold Alt (Option) and click to fetch now-playing info for troubleshooting; click again with Alt to copy to clipboard
mcmusic.backend.unsupported.tooltip: System media is not supported on this operating system
mcmusic.debug.title: Title
